ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there is a circle, at a point on the circle in the upper left there is a tangent ray extending toward the lower left, and another line passes through the circle from the same point and extends to the right, forming a chord/secant. Angle 7 is marked between the tangent and the chord. Below the circle, the arc intercepted by this angle is marked as 196°. Reasoning: Angle 7 is an angle formed by a tangent and a chord. According to the tangent-chord theorem, the measure of the angle formed by a tangent and a chord is equal to half the measure of its intercepted arc. Therefore, ∠7 = 196° ÷ 2 = 98°.

method.method_draft: Inspect the diagram: a tangent ray touches the circle at the upper-left point, and a chord/secant from that same point crosses the circle to the right. The angle labeled 7 is the angle formed by the tangent and the chord. The arc intercepted by this tangent-chord angle is marked 196°. Use the tangent-chord theorem: the measure of an angle formed by a tangent and a chord equals half the measure of its intercepted arc. Therefore, angle 7 = 196° / 2 = 98°.
method.CoT_raw:

推理：角7是由切线和弦形成的角。根据切线-弦定理，切线与弦所成角的度数等于其截弧度数的一半。因此，∠7 = 196° ÷ 2 = 98°。
